summary.en: The lights are down on a product page; a lamp searches it and locks on one card, the camera pushes in low from the side, the card lifts, a light runs twice round it, a note floats beside it, and both settle back.
summary.zh: 关灯的页面上，一束聚光游走后锁定一张卡；镜头推进到斜侧特写，卡片弹起悬浮，一道光沿轮廓跑两圈，旁边浮起两行注记，最后卡和注记一起贴回页面。

fits: The first shot of a "one hero" product opening: one core object (a card, an item, a module) made the protagonist of the film, in its page.
notFor: Pages without a grid of comparable items (the lamp needs something to choose from); more than one hero; fast cutting (it is the slowest, most textured shot, 5.75 s); dark pages (the pool reads by showing a light page in a dark room).

overlaps.note: a lamp that reveals a dark frame; hero-spotlight searches, locks on one card, pushes in and lifts it
a light running round an outline; here it is two laps round the lifted card, part of the scene

intent.en: Make one object the protagonist of the film: of everything on the page, this card; the lamp chooses it, the lift gives it weight, the running light inspects it, and the reseat says it belongs to the page.
intent.zh: 把一个对象立成全片主角：页面上那么多，偏偏是这一张；聚光替观众选中它，弹起给它分量，轮廓光检视它，贴回原位说明它属于这个页面。

content.en: A light page with a grid of comparable cards (tile-card faces or the film's page image) and one hero card (or image); an optional two-line note (each en ≤ 16 chars, zh ≤ 7).
content.zh: 一张有一格格可比较卡片的浅色页面（卡面或影片自己的页面图）和一张主角卡（或图）；可选两行注记（每行英文 ≤ 16 字符，中文 ≤ 7 字）。

fits.zh: “单一主角”式产品开场的第一镜：把一个核心对象（一张卡、一个条目、一个模块）在它的页面里立成全片主角。

notFor.zh: 没有一格格可比较条目的页面（聚光需要有得挑）；不止一个主角；快切（这是最慢、质感最重的一镜，约 5.75 秒）；暗色页面（光池靠暗室里一张亮页面读出来）。

pairs.note: when the hero is drawn from a set first
after the hero, walk through what it carries

en: Open on one hero with the whole arc; a group of cards dancing does not carry a first impression.
Light effects go to the hero only; a glint on every card was rejected twice.
Text on the card blurs in the push-in unless the face is rasterised at high resolution.
End the note's dark backing short of the card's left edge, or it presses a dark wedge onto the card.
zh: 开场直接上单主角加完整动作弧；多卡群舞撑不起第一印象。
光效只给主角；每张卡都闪一下被否过两次。
推进特写时卡上文字会糊，卡面要高分辨率栅格化。
注记的暗色衬底右缘要停在卡左缘之前，否则在卡面左侧压出一道暗楔。

upstream.name: 聚光主角卡
upstream.summary: 关灯的剧场里一束钨丝聚光（带体积光柱）扫过页面锁定一张卡，斜侧推进后卡片弹起悬浮、香槟色光束沿轮廓两圈、连同 3D 注记一起贴回原位
upstream.use: "单一主角"式产品开场；把一个核心对象（卡片/条目/模块）立成全片主角
upstream.energy: 中（质感最高的一镜，节奏慢而稳）
